name: Remaker AI
description_en:
Remaker AI now emphasizes prompt-guided image editing, enhancement and generation, alongside background removal, object erasure, portraits and video-related tools. It is not adequately described only as a face-swap utility.

A user selects the operation, supplies an authorized image or prompt and reviews the returned visual. Editing a photograph can change product or person details even when the intended change is small, so retain and compare the source.
description_zh:
Remaker AI 现强调提示编辑、增强和生成，另含背景移除、擦除、肖像及视频工具，不能只写成换脸工具。

用户选操作、提供授权图/提示并审核结果；即使小修改也可能改变人或商品细节，应保留并对照原图。

core_features.explanation_en: Change a region or scene through image/prompt tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用图片/提示工具修改区域或场景。

core_features.explanation_en: Use upscaling, background removal and erasure utilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用放大、背景移除和擦除。

en: Remove a product background while checking edges and label fidelity.
zh: 移除商品背景并核边缘及标签保真。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose one authorized photo and tool, inspect output/cost and confirm rights before repeated business use.
steps.zh: 选授权照及工具，核结果/费用，重复业务使用前确认权利。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: One-time credit packs, no recurring subscription according to homepage/terms.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Homepage $5.99/200 to $299/20,000 nonexpiring purchased credits, no recurring subscription; signup amount/operation costs unknown. Refund requires first purchase, ≤50 used credits, three-day request and justification.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 首页 $5.99/200 至 $299/20,000，购买额不过期且无自动订阅；赠额/操作费未知。退款须首购、已用≤50、三天内及理由。

sources.title: Remaker AI - The Easiest Way to Recreate Any Image
sources.research_notes_en: Current prompt/image editing, upscaler, background and eraser tools; homepage supplies nonrecurring credit pricing while pricing route is an empty shell.

sources.title: Remaker AI - The Easiest Way to Recreate Any Image
sources.research_notes_en: Official homepage $5.99/200 to $299/20000 credits, purchased credits never expire, signup bonus unspecified.

sources.title: Remaker AI Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.research_notes_en: One-time purchases with first-purchase refund only within three days and no more than fifty credits used; website-material license not clear generated-output license.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.en: For an illustrative low-resolution product image, inspect whether upscaling changes lettering, textures or accessories. Background removal can clip translucent edges, hair and reflections. A sharper-looking result is not evidence that newly visible detail was present in the original. Keep an unedited copy and review the full-size download.
sections.zh: 例如低分辨率商品图，放大后需核字、纹理及配件，移背景可能剪坏透明边、毛发和反射。更锐不证明新细节原本存在，应保原副本并核全尺寸下载。

sections.title_en: Use one-time credits, not an assumed subscription
sections.title_zh: 按一次额度而非假定订阅
sections.en: The homepage states no recurring subscription, purchased credits never expire and packages range from $5.99/200 credits to $299/20,000. The dedicated price route returned only a shell, so intermediate packages and per-tool costs remain unknown. Signup credits have no readable amount. A free basic-feature statement does not establish an unlimited free workflow.
sections.zh: 首页称无自动订阅、购买额度不过期，包从 $5.99/200 到 $299/20,000。独立价格页只返回壳，中间包及各工具消耗未知；注册赠额无可读数量，基本免费不证明无限流程。

sections.title_en: Check the narrow refund conditions before spending
sections.en: Terms allow a refund request only for the account’s first purchase, within three days, with no more than fifty credits used and a reason/supporting information. Approval is not guaranteed by lack of use or subjective dissatisfaction. The generic website-material license is personal/noncommercial; it does not clearly settle generated-output rights. Obtain the applicable output terms for business use.
sections.zh: 条款要求账户首购、三天内、用额不超 50 且提供理由/材料；未用或主观不满意不保证批准。通用网站材料许可限个人非商用，未清晰解决生成输出权利，业务使用需对应条款。

sections.title_en: Pilot one operation and its actual cost
sections.title_zh: 试点一个操作及真实成本
sections.en: Evaluate an authorized background removal or product edit before a batch. Verify quality, downloaded dimensions, credit deduction and visibility settings. The homepage’s zero-data-breach claim was not independently audited. No upload, generation, purchase, refund or export was executed; content/model identity, retention, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.
sections.zh: 批量前先试授权去背景或商品修改，核质量、下载尺寸、扣额及可见性。首页零泄露主张未独立审计。本文未上传、生成、付款、退款或导出，模型、保留、源码许可/自托管未核。

research_gaps: Dedicated pricing response was a shell; package range comes from homepage.
No generation, cost, export, data protection, refund, output license or self-hosting verified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
